title: AgentCancel
description: Result of the agent.cancel JSON-RPC method (nocx-uvac6.2): the backend closes a live agent run after a person's stop request. The cancelled flag is true only when this request closed a non-terminal run; an already-terminal or unknown run is answered with an error. The terminal state is persisted before this result is answered, and the run's already-recorded prose remains in the ledger.

runId.description: The backend-minted run id that was stopped.

state.description: The run state after the stop. A successful cancellation is the cancelled terminal state.

cancelled.description: True because this request stopped the live run.
